visual_direction: Reference-led luminous lotus petals, fine gold-pink-violet gradient linework, deep night atmosphere, refined illustrated landscapes.
format_note: Generated artwork is high-resolution transparent or full-bleed PNG; feature marks, decorative accents, chakra symbols, and charts remain editable SVG with matching PNG exports.
pathway_rule: Astrology & Energy and chakra graphics are pathway restricted. Faith & Religion and Mindful artwork is also pathway restricted. Shared defaults include no chakra symbols or religious emblems.
